title: Зафиксировать successor `2026-09`, semantic/error contract и migration
summary: Создать самодостаточную candidate-ревизию `2026-09`, которая нормативно включает фактически исполненные P2–P5 semantics и имеет один error/state/capability owner с compatibility/migration к `2026-08`.
why: P2–P5 intentionally leave frozen `2026-08` unchanged, so their new refusal, replay, fencing and event-store semantics otherwise remain code-and-plan facts rather than a shared SDK contract. `RAG:—`.

include: Full successor revision and corpus; base revision/tag/digest; changed-rule IDs and coverage; complete error table with producer/category/default retryability/safe-context contract; action/confirmation/token/idempotency/event states and transitions; bounds/capabilities; schema and fixture migration; `candidate` status and deterministic revision-lock shape; compatibility table for `2026-08` consumers.
exclude: Editing frozen `2026-08`; SDK implementation/profile exporters; JCS oracle import; official MCP execution; package exports; full public freeze/tag; inventing missing P2–P5 outputs; changing the behavior of a predecessor contract during transcription.

rules: `2026-09` is self-contained; unchanged norms may be copied with provenance, but every P2–P5 delta gets a new rule ID and compatibility row. Normative Markdown/schema/cases remain owners. `semantic-manifest.json` and `revision.lock.json` are generated later, never hand-edited. Retryability keeps IDE-28's instance override: the table owns a default, cases own actual values. Context allowlists exclude raw token, key material, actor/tenant/approval identifiers, arguments, prompts and hidden-resource existence unless a predecessor contract explicitly permits a redacted field. Every predecessor case maps to a rule and expected semantic result. Revision status remains `candidate`; no git tag. Missing/digest-mismatched predecessor output is dependency-not-ready. Frozen bytes and `spec-2026-08` are read-only.
guidance: Reuse the existing revision grammar and open-wire/closed-authoring schema policy. Prefer explicit compatibility tables over prose such as “mostly compatible”. New hardening rules use a dedicated non-colliding prefix selected in the revision overview and enforced by the linter. Keep wire schemas tolerant; strict authoring variants stay generated. A changed code spelling is a migration entry, not an alias hidden in an SDK.

validation.expect: Source acceptance condition preserved in Validation section.

deliverables: Candidate successor revision/corpus, normative semantic/error/capability contract, complete migration inventory and executable inputs for P6.2–P6.5.
